Name: Maple's Echo
Author: monkdim
Punchline: An in-game accessibility window for Discord voice-to-text callouts.
Description: Displays a Discord channel's live voice-to-text callouts inside FFXIV, in a dedicated, fully customizable window. Built as an accessibility tool: adjustable colors, font size, per-speaker colors, keyword highlighting, and a mistranscription glossary. One-way relay (Discord to game). No fork needed — install, then enter your own Discord bot token and channel in settings; see the README for the one-time Discord setup.
